exp02_aggregate.main_gain: Rare-class macro-F1 +0.0349 and attack-family macro-F1 +0.0105. The CONSISTENT driver across all 3 seeds is Web-BruteForce (baseline F1 0.3636 precision 0.24 -> EXP02 0.678/0.744/0.693, precision 0.73/0.90/0.76), i.e. rare-class precision recovery, NOT the hard pair.
exp02_aggregate.main_tradeoff: Head-1 conservatism: missed-as-benign +0.0024 and correct-attribution -0.0038 (3-seed mean). Benign-false-alarm fell on the 3-seed mean (-0.0022) but rose on seed42 (0.0104), so routing has real seed variance.
exp02_aggregate.hard_pair_finding: attack_loss_weight 1.5 did NOT reliably fix DoS-SlowHTTPTest<->FTP-BruteForce. Only seed42 moved it (SlowHTTPTest recall 0.437->0.522, F1 0.553->0.597). Seed123 (0.431) and seed999 (0.445) stayed at baseline. The pair is feature-limited, as the EXP01 failure analysis predicted.
exp02_aggregate.fragility_note: attack-family macro-F1 mean gain (+0.0105) is only ~1.7x the population std (0.0061); seed999 (0.8509) is barely above baseline (0.8491). The gain is real but fragile and partly carried by one seed.

recommended_exp03.idea: Conservative attack_loss_weight reduction sweep {1.25, 1.35} on the baseline LINEAR Head 2, binary_loss_weight held at 1.0.
recommended_exp03.description: EXP02 (attack_loss_weight 1.5) bought a fragile Head-2/rare-class gain at the cost of Head-1 conservatism (more missed-as-benign, lower correct-attribution). The single lever responsible is the attack-vs-binary loss balance. Backing off from 1.5 toward a knee (1.25, 1.35) should retain most of the consistent Web-BruteForce rare-class precision gain while reducing the conservative Head-1 drift that hurt routing. One factor vs baseline; config-only; no code, no preprocessing, no taxonomy, no model change; binary_loss_weight stays 1.0 to preserve one-factor discipline.
recommended_exp03.screening_design: one_seed_validation_only_screen_then_3seed_confirm: screen {1.25, 1.35} at seed42 choosing the winner ONLY on validation metrics (val attack-family macro-F1 to confirm gain retention + val routing missed-as-benign/correct-attribution to confirm recovery); then run the single winner at seeds 42/123/999 and decide promotion on the 3-seed TEST mean.

candidate_values_rejected_now.1.15: too close to baseline; likely loses the Web-BruteForce rare gain
candidate_values_rejected_now.1.75: too aggressive; 1.5 already raised missed-as-benign and moved the pair in only 1/3 seeds; more weight worsens routing with no reliable Head-2 payoff (A9.6 precedent)

recommended_exp03.selected_seed_strategy: screen at seed42 (validation-only choice, so seed42's optimistic test pair-movement does not drive the decision); confirm the winner at seeds 42/123/999; promote only on the 3-seed test mean beyond the EXP02 noise band; report mean +/- std.
recommended_exp03.expected_benefit: Recover correct-attribution toward >=0.909 and missed-as-benign toward <=0.0538 while keeping attack-family macro-F1 >= ~0.855 and rare-class macro-F1 >= ~0.74 (mostly Web-BruteForce). Best case: a config that beats baseline on Head-2/rare AND does not regress routing -> promotable final.
recommended_exp03.expected_risk: The knee may not exist: lowering the weight could give back the rare-class gain proportionally to the routing recovery (a Pareto wash), leaving baseline still un-beaten on the combined criteria. The hard pair will remain unfixed (feature-limited).

why_selected: It directly targets the EXP03 goal with the single lever proven responsible: the attack-vs-binary loss balance is what bought the Head-2/rare gain AND caused the Head-1 conservatism, so tuning it down is the most direct route to keep one and recover the other.
Config-only, no code change: attack_loss_weight is already wired (hierarchical_trainer.py:266 -> compute_hierarchical_loss); fully reproducible, lowest implementation risk.
Cheapest controlled next step: a 2-value screen + 3-seed confirm (4-6 runs) before committing to any code-change experiment.

Evidence-based: the consistent EXP02 gain is Web-BruteForce rare precision (all 3 seeds), which a smaller weight is likely to retain; the hard pair did not move reliably, so capacity/per-pair tricks are not the lever.
Preserves controlled-experiment discipline: one factor, baseline frozen, isolated paths, >=3 seeds, no test tuning.

why_not_selected_now.validation_only_binary_threshold_calibra: Strong and principled for the missed-as-benign regression, but threshold is hardcoded at 0.5 (hierarchical_trainer.py:242, hierarchical_metrics.py default) so it needs CODE; do it AFTER the cheap config-only sweep and apply it to the chosen final loss config, not a moving target. -> recommend_after_exp03 (EXP04).
why_not_selected_now.head2_focal_loss: Targets the hard pair, but EXP02 showed the pair is feature-limited (moved in only 1/3 seeds); focal needs loss code and risks collapsing rare precision (UNSW A9.7-design). -> recommend_after_exp03 / possible_later.
why_not_selected_now.validation_selection_metric_adjustment: The 0.5/0.5 formula is hardcoded (code change); the EXP01 failure analysis showed baseline and EXP01 both already select their max-val-attack epoch, so re-weighting is unlikely to change the selected epoch for CICIDS. -> possible_later, low priority.
why_not_selected_now.binary_loss_weight_change: Would add a second moving factor; breaks one-factor discipline. Keep binary_loss_weight=1.0 in EXP03; revisit as a separate experiment only if reducing attack_loss_weight alone does not recover routing.
why_not_selected_now.targeted_or_slowhttptest_focused_class_w: Per-class hacking / model-zoo-style tuning with high overfit risk and low reliability given the pair is feature-limited. -> needs_main_control_decision.
why_not_selected_now.attack_only_sampler: The hard pair is NOT rare, so limited upside; oversampling risks overfit/optimism (project disables oversampling by default). -> possible_later.
why_not_selected_now.class_balanced_effective_number_loss: A reweighting variant unlikely to break a feature-overlap pair. -> possible_later.
why_not_selected_now.specialist_module: Model-zoo risk; the project requires one organized final system. -> reject.
why_not_selected_now.feature_engineering: The only real fix for the feature-limited pair, but it is a NEW preprocessing protocol that breaks comparability and is not a quick experiment. -> needs_main_control_decision, only after loss levers are exhausted.
why_not_selected_now.keep_exp02_and_move_on: EXP02 is not routing-clean, so it is not final-ready as-is; revisit only if EXP03 cannot recover routing without giving back the Head-2/rare gain (then main control weighs the trade).

proposed_files_if_approved: results/experiments/cicids_hierarchical_exp03_attack_loss_weight_<value>_seed<seed>/ (test_metrics.json, training_history.csv, per_class_attack_metrics.csv, rare_class_metrics.csv, binary_confusion_matrix.csv, attack_family_confusion_matrix.csv, hierarchical_routing_summary.json, training_config_snapshot.yaml, class_weight_snapshot.json, model_summary.json)
must_not_overwrite: any EXP01 or EXP02 experiment artifact
proposed_manual_command_templates_if_app: # then run the validation-chosen winner at seeds 123 and 999 via per-seed config copies

promotion_criteria.decision_basis: 3-seed (42/123/999) TEST mean of the single validation-chosen winner; report mean +/- std.
promotion_criteria.attack_family_macro_f1_3seed_mean: >= 0.855 (baseline 0.849 + margin beyond the ~+/-0.006 noise band); must hold without losing the Web-BruteForce rare gain
promotion_criteria.rare_class_macro_f1_3seed_mean: >= 0.740 (retain most of the EXP02 rare gain; no rare class -> ~0)
promotion_criteria.correct_attribution_rate_3seed_mean: >= 0.909008 (recovered to baseline or better) -- the core EXP03 objective
promotion_criteria.missed_as_benign_rate_3seed_mean: <= 0.053807 (recovered to baseline or better) -- the core EXP03 objective
promotion_criteria.robustness: no single seed may regress correct-attribution below ~0.900 or missed-as-benign above ~0.058 (avoid lucky-seed promotion)
promotion_criteria.safety: no baseline/EXP01/EXP02 overwrite; validation-only checkpoint selection; train-only class weights; single final test per seed; no test tuning

rejection_criteria: Routing not recovered: correct-attribution still below baseline and missed-as-benign still above baseline on the 3-seed mean.
Head-2/rare gain given back: attack-family macro-F1 < ~0.855 or rare-class macro-F1 < ~0.740 (the reduction simply reverted EXP02).
No knee exists: every candidate is a Pareto wash (gain recovered only in proportion to routing lost) -> stop the loss-weight line, escalate to threshold calibration (EXP04).
Any factor changed beyond attack_loss_weight; any test tuning; any baseline/EXP01/EXP02 artifact overwritten.

binary_routing_protection_decision.method: primarily by NOT over-upweighting attack loss (reduce 1.5 -> 1.25/1.35), keeping binary_loss_weight at 1.0
binary_routing_protection_decision.routing_guardrail_definition: promotion requires correct-attribution >= baseline and missed-as-benign <= baseline on the 3-seed mean (documentation/decision-criteria only; routing summary already reports both -- no code needed)

threshold_calibration_design_if_later_ap.validation_metric_to_select_threshold: maximize validation end-to-end correct-attribution (equivalently minimize validation missed-as-benign) subject to validation benign-false-alarm <= 0.012
threshold_calibration_design_if_later_ap.freeze_procedure: compute the grid on the VALIDATION split at the already validation-selected best checkpoint, pick the winning threshold, write it to the manifest BEFORE evaluating test
threshold_calibration_design_if_later_ap.test_procedure: apply the frozen threshold to the test split exactly once and report
threshold_calibration_design_if_later_ap.leakage_prevention: grid never computed on test; checkpoint selected on validation; threshold selected on validation; single final test; threshold recorded in manifest
threshold_calibration_design_if_later_ap.sequencing: after the EXP03 attack_loss_weight sweep, applied to the chosen final loss config (not a moving target)

slowhttptest_ftp_pair_finding.interpretation: Only seed42 moved the pair; the 3-seed mean is essentially baseline. The pair is feature-limited.
slowhttptest_ftp_pair_finding.reason: Direct per-pair weighting/sampling is model-zoo-style hacking with high overfit risk and low reliability given the pair is feature-limited; the real fix is feature engineering (new preprocessing protocol, needs_main_control), NOT taxonomy/weight tricks.

multi_seed_design.screening_decision_basis: validation metrics only (val attack-family macro-F1 + val routing); NOT seed42 test, because seed42 was the optimistic seed for the hard pair
multi_seed_design.runs_justification: 2 one-seed screens (1.25, 1.35) + run the winner at the 2 remaining seeds (123, 999); the seed42 screen run's once-computed test reused for the 3-seed mean since the screening choice used validation only. Up to 6 if both candidates merit full 3-seed confirmation.
multi_seed_design.avoid_lucky_seed: promotion decided on the 3-seed test mean with a per-seed robustness floor; screening uses validation only; report mean +/- std; require gain beyond the ~+/-0.006 attack-family noise band
